title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Billing Office Rule: Expedited Fees Booked After the Ship Date
content:
## Billing office rule: late booking of an expedited fee

**Rule.** A Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited fee booked late is figured by how many calendar days separate the ship date from the handling date: within 30 days the fee is booked in full; from 31 through 60 days it is prorated, reduced by one percent of the fee for every day beyond the 30th; and after 60 days it is written off and no fee is booked.

The reduction applies to the full amount figured for the order, and it is the last step before that amount is rounded to the nearest cent. The days are calendar days from the ship date on the order's shipment record to the handling date.

### Treatment by days since shipment

| Calendar days from ship date to handling date | Treatment | Share booked |
|---|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | booked in full | 100 percent |
| 31 through 60 | prorated, one percent less for every day beyond the 30th | 99 percent at day 31 down to 70 percent at day 60 |
| more than 60 | written off | nothing booked |

### Worked cases (hypothetical amount of 20.00 as figured for the order)

| Days since shipment | Days beyond the 30th | Share | Amount booked |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | 0 | 100 percent | 20.00 |
| 31 | 1 | 99 percent | 19.80 |
| 45 | 15 | 85 percent | 17.00 |
| 60 | 30 | 70 percent | 14.00 |
| 61 | not applicable | written off | nothing |

### Questions answered

**Is day 30 prorated?** No; a fee booked within 30 days is booked in full.

**What happens after day 60?** The fee is written off and no fee is booked.
